list_accounts.title: List user accounts
list_accounts.description: List the GravityZone user accounts visible to the API key's company, with each account's id, email, role, rights and profile. Use get_account for a single account.

output.description: A page of accounts: page, pagesCount, perPage, total and items.

get_account.title: Get a user account
get_account.description: Read one GravityZone user account's details: email, full name, role, rights, language, timezone and managed targets. With no account_id, returns the account that generated the API key.

account_id.description: Account id. Defaults to the account that generated the API key.

create_account.title: Create a user account
create_account.description: Create a GravityZone user account with a role (Company Administrator, Network Administrator, Reporter or Custom with explicit rights). If no password is given, one is generated and emailed to the user. Returns the new account id.

email.description: Email address for the new account (its login).

phone_country_code.description: Phone country prefix, e.g. +40. Needs phone_subscriber_number.

password.description: Initial password: at least 12 characters with upper, lower, digit and special characters. Omit to have one emailed.

role.description: 1 Company Administrator, 2 Network Administrator, 3 Reporter, 5 Custom (requires rights). Default 1.

rights.description: For role 5 only: booleans such as manageInventory, managePoliciesRead, managePoliciesWrite, manageReports, manageUsers, companyManager, manageRemoteShell.

target_ids.description: Ids of the companies, groups or endpoints the account manages.

output.description: The id of the new account.

update_account.title: Update a user account
update_account.description: Change a GravityZone user account's email, authentication method, password, profile, phone, role, rights or managed targets. Only the fields you pass change. Returns true on success.

account_id.description: Id of the account to update.

authentication_method.description: 0 GravityZone credentials, 1 Identity Provider, 2 GravityZone Identity Provider.

password.description: New password: at least 12 characters with upper, lower, digit and special characters.

profile.description: Profile with fullName, language and timezone (all three required when sent).

role.description: 1 Company Administrator, 2 Network Administrator, 3 Reporter, 5 Custom (requires rights).

rights.description: For role 5 only: booleans such as manageInventory, managePoliciesRead, managePoliciesWrite, manageReports, manageUsers.

target_ids.description: Ids of the targets the account manages.

output.description: True when the account was updated.

delete_account.title: Delete a user account
delete_account.description: Permanently delete a GravityZone user account. Returns true on success. Cannot be undone.

account_id.description: Id of the account to delete.

output.description: True when the account was deleted.

get_notifications_settings.title: Get notification settings
get_notifications_settings.description: Read an account's notification settings: retention, extra email addresses, formatting and each notification type's enabled, visibility and configuration settings.

account_id.description: Account id. Defaults to the account that generated the API key.

configure_notifications_settings.title: Configure notification settings
configure_notifications_settings.description: Change an account's notification settings. Only the notification types listed in notifications_settings are updated; others keep their values. Call get_notifications_settings first to see the current types and shapes.

account_id.description: Account id. Defaults to the account that generated the API key.

delete_after.description: Days after which notifications are deleted (1-365, default 30).

email_addresses.description: Extra email addresses that receive notifications.

include_device_name.description: Include the device name in notification emails.

include_device_fqdn.description: Include the device FQDN in notification emails.

notifications_settings.description: Notification settings objects, each with type, enabled, visibilitySettings and configurationSettings.

send_only_plain_text_email.description: Send notification emails as plain text rather than HTML.

output.description: True when the settings were saved.

get_company.title: Get company details
get_company.description: Read a company's details: name, address, phone, industry, country, contact person, 2FA exemption period and MDR contact. Defaults to the API key's own company.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

update_company.title: Update company details
update_company.description: Update the API key's company profile: name, address, phone, industry, country, state, contact person, 2FA skip period, MDR emergency contact and how updates on closed incidents are handled. Fields not sent are unchanged.

name.description: New unique company name, up to 64 characters.

address.description: Company address, up to 128 characters, no HTML.

phone.description: Company phone number, up to 32 characters.

industry.description: Industry code, e.g. 16 FINANCIAL_SERVICES, 19 HEALTHCARE, 30 TECHNOLOGY, 3007 TECHNOLOGY_SOFTWARE (see the reference for the full list).

state.description: State or primary subdivision, ISO 3166 code.

contact_person.description: Contact person with fullName, email, phoneNumber and companyRole.

skip_2fa_period.description: Days a device may skip two-factor authentication.

mdr_contact_information.description: MDR emergency contact: either phoneNumber {countryPrefix, countryCode, subscriberNumber}, fullName and email, or useDataFromAccount; plus emailVerificationCode for unverified emails (see generate_email_verification_code).

duplicate_closed_incidents_on_update.description: True creates a new incident when a closed one gets updates; false reopens it.

output.description: True when the company was updated.

get_api_key_details.title: Get API key details
get_api_key_details.description: Read which GravityZone APIs the connected API key has enabled and when it was created. Use it to check whether a tool's API (network, reports, incidents...) is available before calling it.

output.description: enabledApis (list of API names) and createdAt.

generate_email_verification_code.title: Send an email verification code
generate_email_verification_code.description: Email a verification code to an address. The code goes in mdrContactInformation.emailVerificationCode when setting an MDR contact with update_company, set_license_key or add_product_key.

email.description: Address the code is sent to.

purpose.description: Purpose of the code: 1 confirms MDR contact information.

output.description: True when the code was sent.

list_incidents.title: List incidents
list_incidents.description: List EDR/XDR incidents, newest first, filtered by endpoint, status, priority, type, main action, assignee or date range. Use get_incident for one incident's full details.

filters.description: Filters: endpointId, status [open, closed, in_progress, false_positive], priority [unknown, low, medium, high, critical], incidentType [incident, extendedIncident], mainAction, assignedUserId, and paired ranges startDate/endDate, processedStartDate/processedEndDate, changeStartDate/changeEndDate (ISO 8601).

output.description: A page of incidents with their ids, type, status, priority, severity and links.

get_incident.title: Get an incident
get_incident.description: Read one incident's full details: involved nodes, detections, status, priority, assignee, notes and link. Use get_incidents_by_ids for up to 10 at once.

get_incidents_by_ids.title: Get several incidents
get_incidents_by_ids.description: Read the full details of up to 10 incidents by id in one call.

change_incident_status.title: Change an incident's status
change_incident_status.description: Set an incident's status: open, investigating, closed as confirmed, or closed as false positive.

type.description: incidents for an endpoint incident, extendedIncidents for an organization (extended) incident.

status.description: 1 Open, 2 Investigating, 3 Closed: confirmed incident, 4 Closed: false positive.

change_incident_priority.title: Change an incident's priority
change_incident_priority.description: Set an incident's priority from unassigned to critical.

type.description: incidents for an endpoint incident, extendedIncidents for an organization (extended) incident.

update_incident_note.title: Set an incident's note
update_incident_note.description: Write the note on an incident, replacing any existing note (up to 50,000 characters).

type.description: incidents for an endpoint incident, extendedIncidents for an organization (extended) incident.

note.description: Note text; replaces the current note.

output.description: True when the note was saved.

add_to_blocklist.title: Add blocklist rules
add_to_blocklist.description: Add rules to the GravityZone Blocklist so endpoints block a file hash, an application path or a network connection. All rules in one call must share the type.

type.description: Rule type for every rule in the call.

rules.description: Rules, each {note?, details}. hash: details {algorithm: sha256|md5, hash}. path: details {path}. connection: details {ruleName, protocol, direction, ipVersion, path?, commandLine?, localAddress?, remoteAddress?, directlyConnected?, operatingSystems?}.

output.description: The result of adding the rules.

list_blocklist_items.title: List blocklist rules
list_blocklist_items.description: List the rules on the GravityZone Blocklist (hashes, paths and connections), with the ids remove_from_blocklist takes.

remove_from_blocklist.title: Remove blocklist rules
remove_from_blocklist.description: Remove rules from the GravityZone Blocklist by id, so the hashes, paths or connections are no longer blocked.

output.description: True when the items were removed.

start_yara_scan.title: Start a YARA scan
start_yara_scan.description: Start an on-demand scan that uses a YARA custom rule to find matching files in the given directories. With no paths, every disk is scanned, which can be heavy.

rule_id.description: Id of the YARA custom rule (24 hex characters).

paths.description: Absolute directories to scan. Omit to scan all drives.

list_custom_rules.title: List custom rules
list_custom_rules.description: List custom detection or exclusion rules (Basic or YARA), with their ids, settings and tags.

subtypes.description: Detection rules only: [0] Basic, [1] YARA, [0,1] both.

create_custom_rule.title: Create a custom rule
create_custom_rule.description: Create a custom detection rule (Basic criteria or YARA) or exclusion rule, optionally limited to endpoints with given tags.

name.description: Unique rule name, up to 128 characters, no <, >, ' or ".

settings.description: Rule settings: status, severity (detection), and for Basic rules target (process|file), criteriaList [{field, relation, value}], filters; for YARA rules yaraQuery; optional automaticActions.

return_rule_id.description: Return the new rule's id instead of true.

output.description: The new rule's id, or true.

update_custom_rule.title: Update a custom rule
update_custom_rule.description: Replace a custom detection or exclusion rule's name, description, tags, settings and targets.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule (24 hex characters).

settings.description: The rule's settings, same shape as create_custom_rule.

output.description: True when the rule was updated.

delete_custom_rule.title: Delete a custom rule
delete_custom_rule.description: Permanently delete a custom detection or exclusion rule.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule (24 hex characters).

output.description: True when the rule was deleted.

isolate_endpoints.title: Isolate endpoints
isolate_endpoints.description: Create tasks that cut endpoints off the network (except GravityZone communication) to contain an incident. Undo with restore_endpoints_from_isolation.

endpoint_ids.description: Endpoint ids (24 hex characters), up to 1000. One invalid id fails the whole call.

restore_endpoints_from_isolation.title: Restore endpoints from isolation
restore_endpoints_from_isolation.description: Create tasks that reconnect isolated endpoints to the network.

endpoint_ids.description: Endpoint ids (24 hex characters), up to 1000.

create_response_action.title: Create an identity or email response action
create_response_action.description: Take a response action on a user or email involved in an incident: reset credentials, disable or enable a Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Google or AWS user, delete emails or files, and similar. Poll the returned action id with get_response_action_status.

action_type.description: Action type, e.g. 1 reset Microsoft 365/Entra ID credentials, 2 reset Active Directory credentials, 3 disable Microsoft 365/Entra ID user, 6 delete an email, 10 delete a file, 11 delete similar emails, 12 AWS user action (see the reference for all values).

incident_id.description: Incident the user node belongs to. Give this or integration_identifiers.

integration_identifiers.description: Integration that imported the user when no incident_id: companyId plus adUserSid, officeTenantId, sensorIdentifier or accessKeyId.

username.description: User involved: an email for Microsoft 365/Google actions, DOMAIN\user for Active Directory.

email_id.description: Email id, for action types 6 and 11.

targets.description: For action type 11 with integration_identifiers: similar emails to delete, each {userId, mailIds} or {similarityHash}.

file_url.description: For action type 10: URL of the file to delete.

get_response_action_status.title: Get a response action's status
get_response_action_status.description: Read the status and outcome of a response action started with create_response_action.

action_id.description: Action id returned by create_response_action (24 hex characters).

get_similar_emails.title: Find similar emails
get_similar_emails.description: List emails similar to a reference email (same campaign), with the user and mail ids create_response_action type 11 takes to delete them.

email_id.description: External id of the reference email.

list_configured_integrations.title: List configured integrations
list_configured_integrations.description: List the Integrations hub integrations configured for a company, with their ids, types and states.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

get_integration.title: Get an integration
get_integration.description: Read one Integrations hub integration's configuration and status.

create_integration.title: Create an integration
create_integration.description: Create an Integrations hub integration (currently VMware vCenter) for a company. Returns the new integration's id.

specifics.description: vCenter settings: hostname, port (443), username, password, retryAuthentication, retryAuthenticationTimeToWait, retryAuthenticationMaxAttempts, verifyTLSCertificate, viewType (1 VMs and templates, 2 hosts and clusters).

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

update_integration.title: Update an integration
update_integration.description: Change an Integrations hub integration's name or connection settings.

specifics.description: Settings to change: hostname, port, username, password, retry and TLS options, viewType.

output.description: True when the integration was updated.

set_integration_state.title: Enable or disable an integration
set_integration_state.description: Enable or disable an Integrations hub integration without deleting it.

output.description: success: true when the state changed.

delete_integration.title: Delete an integration
delete_integration.description: Permanently delete an Integrations hub integration from its company.

output.description: True when the integration was deleted.

get_amazon_ec2_hourly_usage.title: Get Amazon EC2 hourly usage
get_amazon_ec2_hourly_usage.description: Read the hourly usage for each Amazon EC2 instance category in a month.

target_month.description: Month as mm/yyyy. Defaults to the current month.

configure_amazon_ec2_integration.title: Configure the Amazon EC2 integration
configure_amazon_ec2_integration.description: Connect an AWS account to GravityZone through a cross-account IAM role. Generate the external id for the role's trust policy with generate_amazon_ec2_external_id first.

cross_account_role_arn.description: ARN of the AWS cross-account role.

integration_name.description: Name for the integration. Defaults to the AWS account id.

output.description: True when the integration was configured.

generate_amazon_ec2_external_id.title: Generate an Amazon EC2 external id
generate_amazon_ec2_external_id.description: Generate the external id to put in the AWS cross-account role's trust policy. Use get_amazon_ec2_external_id to read an existing one.

get_amazon_ec2_external_id.title: Get the Amazon EC2 external id
get_amazon_ec2_external_id.description: Read the previously generated external id for the AWS cross-account role.

disable_amazon_ec2_integration.title: Disable the Amazon EC2 integration
disable_amazon_ec2_integration.description: Disable a company's Amazon EC2 integration.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

integration_name.description: Name of the integration to disable.

output.description: True when the integration was disabled.

collect_investigation_package.title: Collect an investigation package
collect_investigation_package.description: Start a forensic collection task on an endpoint. Poll with get_investigation_file_url using the returned activity id to get the download link.

retrieve_file_from_endpoint.title: Retrieve a file from an endpoint
retrieve_file_from_endpoint.description: Upload a file from an endpoint to GravityZone storage for investigation. Poll get_investigation_file_url with the returned activity id for the download link.

path.description: Full path of the file on the endpoint.

run_command_on_endpoint.title: Run a command on an endpoint
run_command_on_endpoint.description: Execute a shell command on an endpoint and upload its output as a log file. Poll get_investigation_file_url with the returned activity id for the output.

target_id.description: Endpoint id protected by BEST (24 hex characters).

get_investigation_file_url.title: Get an investigation file's status and link
get_investigation_file_url.description: Read the status and, once finished, the download URL of an activity started with collect_investigation_package, retrieve_file_from_endpoint or run_command_on_endpoint.

target_id.description: Endpoint id the activity ran on.

activity_id.description: Activity id returned when the activity was started.

output.description: The activity's status and file URL.

kill_process.title: Kill a process on an endpoint
kill_process.description: Terminate a running process on a managed endpoint by PID, executable path, or both.

target_id.description: Endpoint id protected by BEST (24 hex characters).

process_id.description: PID of the process. Give this or path.

path.description: Executable path of the process. Give this or process_id.

get_license_info.title: Get license information
get_license_info.description: Read a company's license: subscription type, keys, expiry, seats, used slots and the add-ons it can manage.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

return_all_products.description: Include every product of the company.

set_license_key.title: Set the license key
set_license_key.description: Set the license key of the API key's company, replacing the current key.

mdr_contact_information.description: MDR emergency contact, required for yearly licenses enabling MDR: phoneNumber {countryPrefix, countryCode, subscriberNumber}, fullName, email, emailVerificationCode, or useDataFromAccount / useDataFromCompany.

output.description: True when the key was set.

add_product_key.title: Add a product key
add_product_key.description: Add a base license or add-on key to the API key's company, optionally removing incompatible existing keys.

replace_incompatible_keys.description: Remove existing keys incompatible with this one (default true).

mdr_contact_information.description: MDR emergency contact, required for yearly licenses enabling MDR: phoneNumber {countryPrefix, countryCode, subscriberNumber}, fullName, email, emailVerificationCode, or useDataFromAccount / useDataFromCompany.

output.description: True when the key was added.

remove_product_key.title: Remove a product key
remove_product_key.description: Remove a license or add-on key from the API key's company.

output.description: True when the key was removed.

get_monthly_usage.title: Get monthly license usage
get_monthly_usage.description: Read a company's license usage for endpoints and Exchange mailboxes in a month, optionally for one product type or companies registered in a date range.

product_type.description: 0 Endpoint Security, 3 Bitdefender EDR, 5 Bitdefender PHASR.

usage_coverage_type.description: 3 limits usage to companies created between the registration dates.

company_registration_start_date.description: Companies created after this UTC date.

company_registration_end_date.description: Companies created before this UTC date.

get_monthly_usage_per_product_type.title: Get monthly usage per product type
get_monthly_usage_per_product_type.description: Read a company's license usage in a month broken down for every product type.

target_month.description: Month as mm/yyyy. Defaults to the current month.

list_maintenance_windows.title: List maintenance windows
list_maintenance_windows.description: List the company's maintenance windows (Patch Management) with their ids.

get_maintenance_window.title: Get a maintenance window
get_maintenance_window.description: Read a maintenance window's full settings: download, install and scan schedules.

create_patch_management_maintenance_wind.title: Create a Patch Management maintenance window
create_patch_management_maintenance_wind.description: Create a Patch Management maintenance window that schedules patch scans and installs. Attach it to a policy with assign_maintenance_windows.

allow_change_by_other_users.description: Let other users change the window.

settings.description: Patch Management settings: downloadSettings {cachingServers, fallbackOnDirectDownload}, installPatchesSettings {enabled, updateType, scheduler, postponeReboot, specificVendorAndProduct, manuallyApprovedPatchIds, ...}, scanPatchesSettings {enabled, runOnSystemChanges, scheduler, ...}.

update_patch_management_maintenance_wind.title: Update a Patch Management maintenance window
update_patch_management_maintenance_wind.description: Change a Patch Management maintenance window's name or settings.

settings.description: Patch Management settings: downloadSettings {cachingServers, fallbackOnDirectDownload}, installPatchesSettings {enabled, updateType, scheduler, postponeReboot, specificVendorAndProduct, manuallyApprovedPatchIds, ...}, scanPatchesSettings {enabled, runOnSystemChanges, scheduler, ...}.

allow_change_by_other_users.description: Let other users change the window.

output.description: True when the window was updated.
True when the window was deleted.

assign_maintenance_windows.title: Assign maintenance windows to a policy
assign_maintenance_windows.description: Apply maintenance windows to a policy (at most one per type, same company as the policy).

unassign_maintenance_windows.title: Unassign maintenance windows from a policy
unassign_maintenance_windows.description: Remove maintenance windows from a policy.

get_manually_approved_patches.title: List manually approved patches
get_manually_approved_patches.description: List a company's manually approved patches, with the ids used in a maintenance window's manuallyApprovedPatchIds.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

list_endpoints.title: List endpoints
list_endpoints.description: List endpoints under a company or group, managed or not, with id, name, label, FQDN, group, OS, IP and MAC. Filter by management role, depth, name, MAC or SID. Use list_network_inventory_items to also see groups and companies.

parent_id.description: Company or group id. Defaults to the API key's company targets.

is_managed.description: True for managed endpoints only; omit for all.

filters.description: Filters: security.management {managedWithBest, managedExchangeServers, managedRelays, securityServers}, depth {allItemsRecursively}, details {ssid, macs, name (3+ chars, * prefix for contains)}.

output.description: A page of endpoints: page, pagesCount, perPage, total, hasMoreRecords, items.

get_endpoint.title: Get a managed endpoint
get_endpoint.description: Read a managed endpoint's full details: OS, IPs, agent version, policy, modules, malware status, risk, last seen and optionally scan logs and last logged users.

list_network_inventory_items.title: List network inventory items
list_network_inventory_items.description: List network inventory items (companies, groups, computers, virtual machines, EC2 instances, Active Directory objects) under a company or group.

parent_id.description: Company or group id. Defaults to the API key's company.

filters.description: Filters: type {companies, groups, computers, virtualMachines, ec2Instances}, security.management {managedWithBest, isContainerHost, managedExchangeServers, managedRelays, securityServers}, depth {allItemsRecursively}, details {ssid, macs, name}.

options.description: Options: companies {returnAllProducts, includeRiskScore}, endpoints {returnProductOutdated, includeScanLogs, includeRiskScore}.

set_endpoint_label.title: Label an endpoint
set_endpoint_label.description: Set an endpoint's label (up to 64 characters); an empty string clears it.

label.description: Label, up to 64 characters. Empty string resets it.

output.description: True when the label was set.

move_endpoints.title: Move endpoints to a group
move_endpoints.description: Move endpoints into a custom group; the group's inherited policy then applies to them.

delete_endpoint.title: Delete an endpoint
delete_endpoint.description: Delete an endpoint from the network inventory.

assign_policy.title: Assign a policy to endpoints
assign_policy.description: Assign a security policy to endpoints, or make them inherit from their parent containers.

policy_id.description: Policy to assign. Omit and set inherit_from_above to inherit.

force_policy_inheritance.description: Also apply to all child endpoints (needs policy_id).

get_endpoint_tags.title: List endpoint tags
get_endpoint_tags.description: List endpoint tags (custom and automatic) with their ids, used to target custom rules.

list_custom_groups.title: List custom groups
list_custom_groups.description: List the child groups of a group. With no parent or a company id, returns the 'Computers and Groups' and 'Deleted' groups.

create_custom_group.title: Create a custom group
create_custom_group.description: Create a custom endpoint group under a group or a company's 'Computers and Groups'. Returns the new group's id.

parent_id.description: Parent group or company id. Defaults to the user's company.

move_custom_group.title: Move a custom group
move_custom_group.description: Move a custom group under another custom group.

delete_custom_group.title: Delete a custom group
delete_custom_group.description: Delete a custom group; set force to delete one that still has contents.

force.description: Delete even when not empty (default false).

list_integrators.title: List integrators
list_integrators.description: List the endpoints assigned as integrators for an integration.

add_integrators.title: Add integrators
add_integrators.description: Assign endpoints as integrators for an integration (same company).

remove_integrators.title: Remove integrators
remove_integrators.description: Unassign endpoints from their integrator role.

create_scan_task.title: Scan endpoints
create_scan_task.description: Start a quick, full, memory or custom scan on endpoints or containers. Track it with list_scan_tasks or get_task_status.

custom_scan_settings.description: For type 4: {scanDepth: 1 aggressive|2 normal|3 permissive, scanPath: [paths or LocalDrives]}.

return_all_task_ids.description: Return the ids of every task created.

output.description: The created task ids, or true.

create_scan_task_by_mac.title: Scan endpoints by MAC address
create_scan_task_by_mac.description: Start scans on managed endpoints identified by MAC address (up to 100).

return_task_id.description: Return the new task's id instead of true.

list_scan_tasks.title: List scan tasks
list_scan_tasks.description: List scan tasks, filtered by name (prefix, or *contains) and status.

name.description: Task name prefix; start with * to match anywhere.

get_task_status.title: Get a task's status
get_task_status.description: Read the status of any network task, optionally with its per-endpoint subtasks filtered by status and end time.

subtask_filters.description: Subtask filters: status (1 pending, 2 in progress, 3 finished), endedAfter, endedBefore.

delete_task.title: Delete a task
delete_task.description: Delete a network task (scan, reconfigure, and so on) by id; get ids from list_scan_tasks or task creation.

create_reconfigure_client_task.title: Reconfigure security agents
create_reconfigure_client_task.description: Create a task that reconfigures the security agent on endpoints: modules, scan engines, roles and operation mode, now or on a schedule.

scheduler.description: Schedule: {type: 1 now|2 scheduled, recurrence, everyHour, startTime HH:mm, onWeekDay}.

modules.description: Modules to enable (1) or disable (0): antimalware, advancedThreatControl, firewall, contentControl, deviceControl, powerUser, encryption, edrSensor, advancedAntiExploit, containerProtection, patchManagement, networkAttackDefense, integrityMonitoring...

scan_mode.description: Scan engines: {type: 1 automatic|2 custom, computers {main, fallback}, vms {main, fallback}}.

run_live_search_query.title: Run a Live Search query
run_live_search_query.description: Run an osquery Live Search query on a company's endpoints and upload the results to your S3 bucket.

company_id.description: Company the target endpoints belong to.

query.description: osquery SQL, e.g. select * from time;

endpoints.description: Endpoint ids; an empty list means all endpoints of the company.

operating_systems.description: Operating systems (windows, linux, mac); an empty list means all.

run_gather_logs_task.title: Gather logs from an endpoint
run_gather_logs_task.description: Collect troubleshooting logs from an endpoint to local storage, a network share or an S3 bucket.

log_type.description: Log type to collect: 1, 2 or 3 (see the reference).

storage_options.description: Where logs go: {storageType: 1 local|2 network share|3 S3, localCopyPath, networkSharePath, username, password, s3UploadConfig}.

kill_incident_process.title: Kill a process from an incident
kill_incident_process.description: Terminate a process on an endpoint by PID and executable path, optionally tied to the incident it caused. For investigations without an incident, kill_process takes PID or path alone.

path.description: Path of the executable that started the process.

submit_to_sandbox_analyzer.title: Submit files to Sandbox Analyzer
submit_to_sandbox_analyzer.description: Create a task that pulls up to 5 files from a Windows endpoint and detonates them in Sandbox Analyzer.

command_lines.description: Up to 10 command lines telling the sandbox how to run a sample.

list_packages.title: List installation packages
list_packages.description: List a company's installation packages with their ids and names.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

get_package.title: Get an installation package
get_package.description: Read an installation package's configuration: modules, scan mode, roles, deployment options and settings.

create_package.title: Create an installation package
create_package.description: Create a security agent installation package. Get its download links with get_installation_links.

language.description: Language: en_US, es_ES, de_DE, fr_FR, ro_RO, pl_PL, pt_BR, it_IT or ru_RU (default en_US).

modules.description: Modules on (1) or off (0): antimalware, advancedThreatControl, firewall, userControl, antiphishing, trafficScan, deviceControl, powerUser, encryption, edrSensor, advancedAntiExploit, containerProtection, patchManagement, networkAttackDefense, integrityMonitoring, phasr.

scan_mode.description: Scan mode: {type: 1 automatic|2 custom, computers, vms, ec2: {main, fallback}}.

settings.description: Other settings: removeCompetitors, uninstallPassword, customInstallationPath, customGroupId, vmsCustomGroupId.

deployment_options.description: Deployment: {type: 1 update server|2 relay, relayId, useCommunicationProxy, proxyServer, proxyPort, proxyUsername, proxyPassword}.

product_type.description: 0 detection and prevention, 3 EDR (report only), 5 PHASR standalone.

company_id.description: Company the package belongs to.

output.description: The new package's id and name.

update_package.title: Update an installation package
update_package.description: Change an installation package's name, modules, scan mode, settings, roles or deployment options.

language.description: Language: en_US, es_ES, de_DE, fr_FR, ro_RO, pl_PL, pt_BR, it_IT or ru_RU (default en_US).

modules.description: Modules on (1) or off (0): antimalware, advancedThreatControl, firewall, userControl, antiphishing, trafficScan, deviceControl, powerUser, encryption, edrSensor, advancedAntiExploit, containerProtection, patchManagement, networkAttackDefense, integrityMonitoring, phasr.

scan_mode.description: Scan mode: {type: 1 automatic|2 custom, computers, vms, ec2: {main, fallback}}.

settings.description: Other settings: removeCompetitors, uninstallPassword, customInstallationPath, customGroupId, vmsCustomGroupId.

deployment_options.description: Deployment: {type: 1 update server|2 relay, relayId, useCommunicationProxy, proxyServer, proxyPort, proxyUsername, proxyPassword}.

product_type.description: 0 detection and prevention, 3 EDR (report only), 5 PHASR standalone.

company_id.description: Company the package belongs to.

delete_package.title: Delete an installation package
delete_package.description: Permanently delete an installation package; existing download links stop working.

get_installation_links.title: Get installation links
get_installation_links.description: Get download links for installation packages, per company, package and staging ring.

company_id.description: Managed company. Omit for all managed companies.

package_name.description: Package name. Omit for all packages.

ring_id.description: Staging ring: 0 slow, 3 production, 4 test 1, 5 test 2 (default 0).

output.description: Installation links per package and OS.

get_installed_patches.title: List installed patches
get_installed_patches.description: List installed patches for endpoints or a whole company, filtered by patch type and severity.

company_id.description: Company to report on instead of specific endpoints.

filters.description: Filters: type (0 security, 1 non-security, 2 manually approved), severity (0 none, 1 low, 2 moderate, 3 important, 4 critical, 5 unassigned).

get_missing_patches.title: List missing patches
get_missing_patches.description: List missing patches for endpoints or a whole company, filtered by patch type and severity.

company_id.description: Company to report on instead of specific endpoints.

filters.description: Filters: type (0 security, 1 non-security, 2 manually approved), severity (0 none, 1 low, 2 moderate, 3 important, 4 critical, 5 unassigned).

get_monitored_rules.title: List PHASR monitored rules
get_monitored_rules.description: List PHASR monitored rules (tampering, hack, remote tools, miners, LOLBins) with their ids.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

categories.description: Categories: 1 tampering tool, 2 hack tool, 3 remote tool, 4 miner, 5 LOLBin.

get_monitored_rule_data.title: Get PHASR rule data
get_monitored_rule_data.description: List the behavioral profiles (user and device pairs) observed for a PHASR rule, filtered by profile type.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

profile_type.description: 1 using tools, 2 not using tools, 3 restricted by autopilot, 4 restricted by direct control.

edit_monitored_rules_access.title: Allow or restrict PHASR access
edit_monitored_rules_access.description: Allow or restrict behavioral profiles' access to the tools a PHASR rule monitors.

targets.description: Behavioral profile ids (identityId joined with a device resourceId).

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

get_phasr_recommendations.title: List PHASR recommendations
get_phasr_recommendations.description: List PHASR recommendations to allow or restrict tool access, filtered by rule, category, action taken, type, date and profile.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

category_ids.description: 1 tampering tool, 2 hack tool, 3 remote tool, 4 miner, 5 LOLBin.

action_taken.description: 0 action needed, 1 applied, and other statuses from the reference.

type.description: 0 allow access, 1 restrict access, 2 allow access request.

get_recommendation_profiles.title: List a recommendation's profiles
get_recommendation_profiles.description: List the behavioral profiles a PHASR recommendation applies to.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

apply_recommendations.title: Apply PHASR recommendations
apply_recommendations.description: Apply PHASR recommendations (same company) so their allow or restrict decisions take effect.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

take_request_access_action.title: Answer PHASR access requests
take_request_access_action.description: Allow or deny users' access requests raised as PHASR recommendations.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

get_all_company_identities.title: List PHASR identities
get_all_company_identities.description: List the user identities PHASR knows for a company, optionally filtered by name.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

get_all_company_resources.title: List PHASR resources
get_all_company_resources.description: List the devices (resources) PHASR knows for a company, optionally filtered by name.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

list_policies.title: List policies
list_policies.description: List a company's security policies with their ids and names.

company_id.description: Company id. Defaults to the company that owns the API key.

get_policy.title: Get a policy
get_policy.description: Read a security policy's full settings, module by module. Get policy ids from list_policies.

set_policy_modules_state.title: Turn policy modules on or off
set_policy_modules_state.description: Enable or disable protection modules in a policy, e.g. on-access scanning, advanced threat control, firewall, network protection, encryption, incidents sensor or blocklist.

get_push_event_settings.title: Get event push settings
get_push_event_settings.description: Read the event push service settings: status, service type, destination and subscribed event types.

set_push_event_settings.title: Configure event push
set_push_event_settings.description: Configure which GravityZone events are pushed to your web service or SIEM (JSON-RPC, Splunk, CEF, QRadar, Sentinel).

service_settings.description: Destination settings, e.g. {url, authorization, requireValidSslCertificate} for jsonRPC.

subscribe_to_event_types.description: Event types to send, e.g. {"av": true, "new-incident": true, "task-status": true}.

send_test_push_event.title: Send a test push event
send_test_push_event.description: Send a test event of a given type to the configured push destination.

event_type.description: Event type, e.g. av, new-incident, task-status, hwid-change, adcloud.

data.description: Fields overriding the test event template.

get_push_event_stats.title: Get event push statistics
get_push_event_stats.description: Read event push statistics: events sent, errors and last errors.

reset_push_event_stats.title: Reset event push statistics
reset_push_event_stats.description: Reset the event push statistics and error counters to zero.

list_quarantine_items.title: List quarantined items
list_quarantine_items.description: List quarantined files (computers) or emails (Exchange), for one endpoint or the whole network, filtered by threat, date, path, hash, IP or action status.

endpoint_id.description: Endpoint id. Omit for the whole network.

filters.description: Filters: threatName, startDate, endDate (ISO 8601), and for computers filePath, fileSha256, ip, actionStatus.

remove_quarantine_items.title: Delete quarantined files
remove_quarantine_items.description: Create a task that permanently deletes quarantined files from endpoints.

empty_quarantine.title: Empty the quarantine
empty_quarantine.description: Create a task that deletes every quarantined file on the network's computers.

restore_quarantine_items.title: Restore quarantined files
restore_quarantine_items.description: Create a task that restores quarantined files to their original or a given location, optionally excluding them from future scans.

location_to_restore.description: Absolute folder to restore into. Defaults to the original location.

add_exclusion_in_policy.description: Exclude the restored files from future scans (default false).

add_file_to_quarantine.title: Quarantine a file
add_file_to_quarantine.description: Create a task that quarantines a file by path on up to 100 endpoints (detection and prevention mode with EDR sensor).

file_path.description: Absolute file path on the endpoint.

restore_quarantine_exchange_items.title: Restore quarantined Exchange emails
restore_quarantine_exchange_items.description: Create a task that restores quarantined Exchange items to mailboxes, using an Exchange user's credentials.

email.description: Email address when it differs from the username.

ews_url.description: Exchange Web Services URL when Autodiscovery fails.

release_quarantine_exchange_items.title: Release quarantined Exchange emails
release_quarantine_exchange_items.description: Create a task that releases quarantined Exchange emails to their recipients.

list_reports.title: List reports
list_reports.description: List scheduled reports, filtered by name and type, with the ids get_report_download_links takes.

type.description: Report type number, e.g. 8 Endpoint Protection Status, 12 Malware Status, 13 Monthly License Usage.

create_report.title: Create a report
create_report.description: Create an instant report, or a scheduled one emailed to a list. Returns the report id; fetch the files with get_report_download_links.

type.description: Report type: 1 Antiphishing Activity, 2 Blocked Applications, 3 Blocked Websites, 4 Customer Status Overview, 5 Data Protection, 6 Device Control Activity, 7 Endpoint Modules Status, 8 Endpoint Protection Status, 9 Firewall Activity, 10 License Status, 12 Malware Status, 13 Monthly License Usage, 14 Network Status, 15 On demand scanning, 16 Policy Compliance, 17 Security Audit, 18 Security Server Status, 19 Top 10 Detected Malware, 20 Top 10 Infected Companies, 21 Top 10 Infected Endpoints, 22 Update Status, 23 Upgrade Status, 24 AWS Monthly Usage, 30 Endpoint Encryption Status, 31 HyperDetect Activity, 32 Network Patch Status, 33 Sandbox Analyzer Failed Submissions, 34 Network Incidents, 35 MDR Service Status, 36-37 Integrity Monitoring, 38 Mobile Security Monthly License Usage, 39 Data Insights License Usage, 40 Extended Email Security Usage.

target_ids.description: Targets: companies, groups, containers or endpoints depending on the type.

scheduled_info.description: Schedule: {occurrence: 2 hourly|3 daily|4 weekly|5 monthly|6 yearly, interval, startHour, startMinute, days, day, month}. Omit for an instant report.

get_report_download_links.title: Get report download links
get_report_download_links.description: Get the download links of a report's instant and last scheduled runs.

delete_report.title: Delete a report
delete_report.description: Permanently delete a report and its scheduled runs. Cannot be undone.
